findings.title: Attack path to Deployment shop/api
findings.message: Reachable from outside through LoadBalancer api-public → Its token can read Secrets in every namespace

findings.title: Bound to the built-in cluster-admin role
findings.message: ServiceAccount ci/deployer via ClusterRole:cluster-admin: cluster-admin can do anything in any namespace.

controls.name: Ensure that the cluster-admin role is only used where required

findings.title: PodDisruptionBudget policy/v1beta1 is removed in Kubernetes 1.25
findings.message: This cluster still serves policy/v1beta1, 1 minor release before its removal. Move manifests to policy/v1.

findings.title: One replica and no PodDisruptionBudget
findings.message: Deployment shop/api: 1 replica and no PodDisruptionBudget

findings.title: No NetworkPolicy selects these pods
findings.message: 2 pods of app api in shop: the namespace has no NetworkPolicy.

controls.name: Ensure that all Namespaces have Network Policies defined

findings.title: Secrets read into environment variables
findings.message: 2 pods of app api in shop read Secret db-creds into environment variables.

controls.name: Prefer using Secrets as files over Secrets as environment variables

findings.title: Default ServiceAccount token mounted
findings.message: 3 pods of app web in shop run as the default ServiceAccount with its API token mounted.

controls.name: Ensure that default service accounts are not actively used
Ensure that Service Account Tokens are only mounted where necessary

findings.title: Image signatures aren't enforced
findings.message: Nothing enforces image signatures in namespace shop.

controls.name: Configure Image Provenance using ImagePolicyWebhook admission controller
